name: Seattle Counselor In Training (CIT) Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at a summer day camp. All-Time Belayers belay and coach campers on climbing walls. Junior Counselors work with a mentor counselor, help keep a camp group safe and co-lead games and activities.
who_can_apply: Teens and camp grads ages 13 to 17. All-Time Belayer: ages 13 to 17. Junior Counselor: ages 15 to 17. You do not need camp or climbing experience; training is given.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. Junior Counselors can join a Camp Alumni Adventure trip at a highly discounted rate.
duration: All-Time Belayer: 9 am to noon, at least 6 days. Junior Counselor: 9 am to 4 pm, at least 2 weeks.
deadline_text: Applications for summer 2027 open in March 2027 (no exact day posted). Summer 2026 applications are closed.
how_to_apply: Apply on the CIT page when applications open in March 2027. Questions: summercamp@mountaineers.org.
notes: A nonprofit summer camp, not Seattle Parks. Pick the weeks that fit your schedule. Unpaid volunteer role; Washington L&I says its minor work rules apply to employees, not volunteers.
